name: beziera-workspace
description: Monorepo root for Beziera — never published itself. The published package is packages/cli, named "beziera" (see its own package.json).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@beziera/core && npm run build --workspace=@beziera/mcp && npm run build --workspace=@beziera/canvas && npm run build --workspace=beziera
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace=@beziera/core && npm run test --workspace=@beziera/mcp && npm run test --workspace=@beziera/canvas && npm run test --workspace=beziera
